title: Guadalajara Cathedral
scope: The standing Cathedral of the Assumption of Mary in Guadalajara, including its symmetrical western towers, principal basilican mass and roof, and attached eastern volumes. The separately named Sagrario Metropolitano is excluded.
limitations: The surviving cathedral and its measured tower heights are represented. The separately named Sagrario, city plaza furniture and cathedral interiors are outside this model’s scope.

The mapped 76 metre long cathedral envelope controls the local model. Published larger dimensions encompass the wider architectural site. The exact side aisle segmentation, stone ornament, roof levels and lantern detail are approximated.
Landings are tied to the preserved source terrain. Older plaza grading and the demolished atrium are outside the represented era.
